name: bare-tls
description: Transport Layer Security (TLS) streams for JavaScript

exports.name: createServer
signatures: createServer(opts?: TLSSocketOptions, onconnection?: (socket: TLSSocket) => void): TLSNetServer
exports.description: Creates a TLS server that listens for TCP connections and wraps them with TLS. Incoming connections are emitted as `'connection'` events with a `tls.Socket` instance. Options are the same as `tls.Socket`, plus any options supported by <https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-net>.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options applied to each incoming socket; the same as `TLSSocket`, plus any options supported by `bare-net`.

exports.name: createConnection
signatures: createConnection(opts: TLSSocketOptions & { port: number; host?: string }, onconnect?: () => void): TLSSocket
createConnection(port: number, host?: string, onconnect?: () => void): TLSSocket
exports.description: Creates a TCP connection and wraps it with TLS. `opts` are passed to both the underlying TCP socket and `TLSSocket`. At minimum, `port` must be specified.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options passed to both the underlying TCP socket and `TLSSocket`; `port` is required and `host` defaults to `'localhost'`.

params.name: onconnect
params.description: Called when the connection is established.

exports.name: constants
exports.description: Internal state flags used by `TLSSocket`, such as `state.CONNECTED`.

exports.name: errors
exports.description: An error produced by a failed TLS operation; `code` identifies the failure.

members.name: errors.from
members.description: Create a `TLSError` from `err`, copying its message and code.

exports.name: TLSSocketEvents
signatures:
interface TLSSocketEvents {
  connect: []
  data: [data: unknown]
  end: []
  readable: []
  piping: [dest: Writable]
  close: []
  error: [err: Error]
  drain: []
  finish: []
  pipe: [src: Readable]
}

members.name: connect
members.description: Emitted when the TLS handshake completes.

exports.name: TLSSocketOptions
signatures:
interface TLSSocketOptions {
  isServer?: boolean
  cert?: ArrayBufferView
  key?: ArrayBufferView
  host?: string
  rejectUnauthorized?: boolean
  ca?: ArrayBufferView
  alpnProtocols?: string[]
  eagerOpen?: boolean
  allowHalfOpen?: boolean
  readBufferSize?: number
}

members.name: allowHalfOpen
members.description: Whether to allow half-open connections. Defaults to `true`.

members.name: alpnProtocols
members.description: An array of ALPN protocol name strings, ordered by preference. Defaults to `null`.

members.name: ca
members.description: A `Buffer` of one or more PEM-encoded CA certificates; when provided, only these CAs are used for verification instead of the bundled Mozilla root certificates. Defaults to `null`.

members.name: cert
members.description: A `Buffer` containing PEM-encoded certificate data. Defaults to `null`.

members.name: eagerOpen
members.description: Whether to open the stream eagerly. Defaults to `true`.

members.name: host
members.description: The hostname to verify the server certificate against; DNS names are also sent as the SNI extension, while IP literals are matched against the certificate's IP SANs with SNI suppressed. Required for client sockets unless `rejectUnauthorized` is `false`.

members.name: isServer
members.description: Whether the socket acts as a TLS server or client; if `true`, `cert` and `key` must be provided. Defaults to `false`.

members.name: key
members.description: A `Buffer` containing PEM-encoded private key data. Defaults to `null`.

members.name: readBufferSize
members.description: The size in bytes of the read buffer. Defaults to `65536`.

members.name: rejectUnauthorized
members.description: Whether the client rejects connections when certificate verification fails. Defaults to `true`.

exports.name: TLSSocket
signatures:
interface TLSSocket<M extends TLSSocketEvents = TLSSocketEvents> {
  readonly socket: Duplex
  readonly encrypted: true
  readonly alpnProtocol: string | null
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  write(data: unknown, encoding?: BufferEncoding, cb?: StreamCallback): boolean
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
}
